notes: group_id G-<lowest ABN> is an entity group: providers sharing an ABN or ACN (link_reason shared_abn, shared_acn, shared_abn_and_acn). group_id BN-<PR> is a business-name overlap flag: the holder's ABR business name equals the named provider's ACECQA Legal or Trading Name after normalisation; a shared brand is not evidence of common ownership. Parent and subsidiary relationships are NOT derivable from free ABR data: they need paid ASIC extracts and are out of scope. A group here is one legal entity (one ABN or ACN) holding several provider approvals, nothing more.
